rounds.text: Arvind Port & Infra Ltd currently trades at a P/E of 81x, which represents a significant premium over the sector benchmark of 59.97x [E1, E6]. This valuation is increasingly difficult to justify given that the company’s ROE of 0.79% drastically underperforms the sector benchmark of 5.16% [E8]. Furthermore, the company’s growth trajectory is stalling, evidenced by a -40% decline in compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months and a -10% YoY drop in sales [E14, E55]. The market’s expectations appear detached from current performance, as price growth has outpaced profit growth by 45% [E41]. Investors are also receiving no immediate return on their capital, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the company has achieved 97% compounded sales growth over 5 years and maintains a P/B ratio of 0.64x, which is well below the sector benchmark of 3.16x [E2, E7, E12].
